notes:
Hand an asset back from the app.

Everything the company has issued to you is on Assets, each with a Return
button. Add a note if it helps ("left it with IT at reception") and HR is
told. It stays on your list until they confirm they have it; if they cannot
take it back yet, you see why and can ask again.

One asset, many people.

An asset is now a kind of thing — Laptop, Phone — that can be issued to
several people at once, each with the item they actually got: one person's
Laptop is a MacBook i5, the next an Asus i7, 6GB RAM, 1TB ROM, each with its
own serial and sticker number. Whoever looks after assets issues it to a whole
list of people in one go, corrects an item, or takes it back with the date and
the condition it came back in. Return requests wait on a new Returns tab, with
a count on the Assets menu.

Exits: the assets come up.

When HR opens an exit, whatever company property the person still holds pops
up, and each item can be marked returned right there. Picking the employee
when starting an exit shows the same list, and completing an exit with items
still out asks first.

Exit alerts now open the Exits screen instead of the alerts list, and a
pinned shortcut shows its count on the home screen.
